answer: Score every identity by trust flow: start from a few human-verified root agents and let trust propagate outward, thinning with each hop. A voucher has a fixed trust budget, so blessing one puppet costs a velvet-soft fraction of blessing ten. When the flow reaches a dense clique of mutual vouches with almost no inbound trust from outside, the delta between claimed and received trust exposes the farm: puppets split one thin stream instead of each drawing a full plume of reward. Minting needs flow above an epoch threshold — trust earned downstream of real roots, never manufactured in a circle.
